text_block_list.text:
During a break in training, Oguri Cap is 
talking with an underclassman Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Oguri-senpai. Well 
then, excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was just getting some advice about my 
running style.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm not good at conveying things to 
others, but lately... yeah, I've gotten a 
bit better at speaking than before.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I feel like people have 
been coming to me for advice more often, 
just like this.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It is because you have always listened 
carefully to what I had to say, Trainer. 
...Thank you."

Seeing Oguri Cap's bashful smile, I felt 
truly glad all over again to be her 
Trainer.
